coverageNotes: Cook County partial official specimen-ballot coverage: countywide offices, Metropolitan Water Reclamation District full and unexpired terms, commissioner districts9/14/15/17, Board of Review districts1/2, countywide judicial vacancies, subcircuits13/18 and31 individual retention questions. Other Cook contests and remaining retention questions remain under acquisition.

Chicago is a separate election authority. Its current October27 candidate inventory is preserved as a lead; Chicago school president and20 school subdistrict specimen ballots are not yet acquired. No conclusion about the absence of any Chicago, municipal, school or special-district race is made.

District contests retain their precise district division keys. Commissioner, Board of Review, judicial subcircuit and MWRD keys are not yet in the held Illinois registry and need exact geographic joins for address-specific reader delivery. Countywide facts can serve Chicago and suburban Cook where the office electorate is countywide.
Declared write-in candidates are separate coverage work. Blank write-in slots printed on these ballots are not candidates; no named declared write-in certification was acquired.
